fieldData.description: Join us on the first ever Radix India meet up happening in Chennai, India. The event is a social meetup for those who are new to crypto as well as those who are experts in this field. We will begin the event with an informal networking session. The event will continue with an introduction from the host and a video session of Radix Alexandria Preview Event (APE). We will conclude the event by a short Q&A session. We have also arranged for a BBQ dinner and some merch giveaways for the attendees, so be sure to stay after the event. Feel free to reach out to me in case of any doubts or clarifications regarding the event. 9980043260- Taha Mohammed Radix Website: https://www.radixdlt.com/ Radix Telegram: https://t.me/radix_dlt Radix MeetUp: https://t.me/Radix_Meetup Radix Discord: https://t.co/K2bV4gNFl8
